surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions of metal-organics are expected to be modified by photo-irradiation. The decomposition of metal-organics takes place only on a heated substrate, which brings about crystal growth dominated by surface reactions. The UV light is thought to be adsorbed by TEGa on a growing surface.
